Goal.description: A stable end an actor is pursuing. Distinct from traj:goalRealizingTransition.

properties.name: pursuedBy
properties.description: The actor who holds this goal.

Option.description: A means available at a state for a goal, whether or not it was walked.

properties.name: availableAt
properties.description: State at which the option is on the menu.

properties.name: enactedTransition
properties.description: The walked transition, if this option was chosen.

OptionAssessment.description: Inferred friction and feasibility reading. Not a utility.

OffenderCapability.description: What a particular actor can bring to an option. Local stand-in for UCO issue 682.

Constraint.description: A wall, guardian, or access denial that removes an option from the menu.

Selection.description: Inferred pick from a menu of at least two options. selectionRule may be not_modeled. No reward.
